notes.title: Heck City Delivery - Demo Achievements Update
notes.content:
We're excited to announce an update to the Heck City Delivery Demo! This update brings eight new achievements to the game, giving players even more challenges to overcome as they race through the streets of Heck City.

With new objectives and obstacles to overcome, this update will push your driving abilities to the limit. Can you rise to the challenge and become the raddest gobbie ever?
